title: Perception-to-imagery object decoding
scientific_question: Can a perception-trained within-person decoder rank the instructed imagery category among50 fixed candidate categories, and does access to neural observations improve over matched no-neural/permuted-training controls?
primary_outputs: The instructed category for each imagery trial, withheld until predictions freeze; this is not a recovered photograph or an independent verification of subjective imagery content.

missing_or_unverified: No exact input asset record was extracted from the linked readiness manifest; inspect the pinned source audit before acquisition.
This specification does not establish a local public/private packet, payload equality or an executed task adapter.

inputs: Processed within-person ROI_VC fMRI with perception support and a fixed candidate category feature bank using all 1000 cnn7 units.
Source arms neural, no_neural and training_permuted; paired access conditions differ by selected official code-body access only.
forbidden_inputs: Query category labels, cue-bearing filenames/trial ordering metadata and label-based imagery averaging before prediction freeze.
Imagery-informed voxel/feature selection and use of target categories in perception decoder fitting contrary to frozen category split.
allowed_inputs.case_identity: Source protocol emits Subject1..Subject5/{neural,no_neural,training_permuted}/{imagery,perception}; paired grading adds two access conditions for60 required cases, each with fixed complete trial rows.
allowed_inputs.split: Within-person perception support then blinded imagery/perception queries; preserve category/run/repetition groups. Trusted grader alone may average frozen score vectors by hidden category; new-person transfer is outside scope.
allowed_inputs.coverage: Allfive people, three arms, two phases and two access conditions:60 cases. Each imagery case has500 trials (10 per50 categories); perception1750 trials (35 per category). Fixed ROI_VC and all 1000 cnn7 units are a declared feature/ROI scope, not the complete 13-family/10-ROI hierarchy task.

biological_unit: Five biological participants; categories and repeated trials remain nested/dependent.
case_definition: One imagery or perception trial within person; grading contexts are person×arm×phase×access condition.

split.policy: Within-person perception support then blinded imagery/perception queries; preserve category/run/repetition groups. Trusted grader alone may average frozen score vectors by hidden category; new-person transfer is outside scope.
split.coverage: Allfive people, three arms, two phases and two access conditions:60 cases. Each imagery case has500 trials (10 per50 categories); perception1750 trials (35 per category). Fixed ROI_VC and all 1000 cnn7 units are a declared feature/ROI scope, not the complete 13-family/10-ROI hierarchy task.

reference.role: Pinned perception-to-feature/category analysis source. Python100-unit OLS and MATLAB200-iteration defaults differ from the paper recipe; no implementation is execution-qualified here.

controls: Category-name cues and category priors remain alternative explanations even after hidden query label removal.
Use all 1000 units and train-only voxel selection; never select units based on imagery outcomes.
All60 admissions precede protected gold access; label-based aggregation is grader-only and after freeze.

direct_observation.boundary: Preserve complete permitted evidence and hide cue labels; direct performance cannot be inferred from programme grades.

typed_viewer.boundary: Rendering must retain specified observations, avoid labels and prevent raw-array/file retrieval.
missing: No typed viewer or matched view budget

tool_assisted.representation: Paired access/code exposure is not an implemented case-adaptive investigation transport.
tool_assisted.boundary: A future matched tool-assisted condition must hold observations, reference tools and resource budget fixed.
missing: No separate case-adaptive participant runtime shown

Producer source is present, but its external transport/lifecycle/stager dependencies and native environment are not a complete admitted public execution closure.

primary.name: Equal-person imagery/neural trial fractional-tie Top-1 accuracy
primary.aggregation: Each complete 500-trial imagery/neural case averages1/number-of-top-ties if the true class ties for maximum, otherwise0; mean equally acrossfive participants, with paired access effects reported separately.
primary.rationale: Measures unambiguous50-way trial identification and handles ties without rewarding flat scores as perfect rank-fraction performance.

secondary: Mean midrank and pairwise-half-ties score, separate from historical strict-greater diagnostic.
Private category-mean score-vector metrics after freeze; distinguish from averaging neural features before correlation.
Paired access B-minus-A effects and neural-minus-no_neural/training_permuted control interactions; perception transfer diagnostic.

comparators.name: No-neural arm
comparators.inputs: Candidate bank and allowed non-neural/perception-training context
comparators.procedure: Implemented matched information control; flat scores imply1/50 Top-1, not perfect recovery.

comparators.name: Training-permuted arm
comparators.inputs: Same neural observations with frozen source-defined training association permutation
comparators.procedure: Implemented negative control for learned perception-to-feature association; preserve valid adverse effects.

comparators.name: Perception-trained feature decoder
comparators.inputs: Same allowed perception fMRI and fixed cnn7 bank
comparators.procedure: Competent decoder recipe must be frozen and independently qualified; official Python demo defaults must not be equated with the paper recipe.

nuisance_controls: Category-name cues and category priors remain alternative explanations even after hidden query label removal.
Use all 1000 units and train-only voxel selection; never select units based on imagery outcomes.
All60 admissions precede protected gold access; label-based aggregation is grader-only and after freeze.
evaluation.uncertainty: Report all five participant effects and matched controls. Existing paired grading effects are descriptive; neither many trials nor access repetitions increase biological n, and no significance threshold is established.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require complete60 cases, exact50-category panels,500/1750 rows and finite bounded score arrays before gold reads. Preserve malformed/incomplete producer outcomes; no cherry-picked subset score.

resources.basis: Unmeasured estimate. Use bounded existing derivatives/reference features; full-source procurement and model training are not implied.
